run_train_qa: run the multi-hop dense retrieval QA model training script with configurable epochs and batch size
run_predict_qa: run prediction on a QA dataset using a trained multi-hop dense retrieval model checkpoint
run_eval_final_qa: run final evaluation and generate submission predictions for the HotpotQA dataset with a fixed weight
review_load_saved: review the load_saved function that loads a PyTorch model state dict and strips module prefixes
review_predict: review the predict function that evaluates chain ranking accuracy and answer span extraction with threshold search
